summary: the cases of the audio suite on i686, against an HDA stream that raises no interrupt at the end of a buffer and an SB16 that plays stereo as mono

argv: ARCH=i686 sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2 && ARCH=i686 sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} rach2/kernel

faults.name: no-ioc
faults.summary: the stream's buffer descriptors ask for no interrupt on completion, so the controller sends no message while it plays and the timer's service alone feeds the notes

lines: machine.audio.hda on i686: failure: messages failed: the controller's message vector counted 0 before the scale

faults.name: stereo
faults.summary: the stereo bit left out of the DSP's mode, so the device plays each channel's sample as a frame of its own and wavcheck finds the tones an octave low

lines: machine.audio.sb16 on i686: failure: notes failed: wavcheck exited
